summary: Resource-manager node removal. Decrements the reference count of the node a2 via ReferenceCountedResourceRelease; only when the count reaches 0 does it continue: format an already-deleted message into a local buffer if the node's state word is -1, decrement one of four category counters (this+0x14..+0x20) selected by bits 0x20/0x100 of the state word, splice the node out of the doubly linked list by relinking a2[47]/a2[48] neighbor pointers, update the list head this+0x24 if the removed node was head, free the node's internal arrays and memory, and decrement the total count this+0x10.

local_names.this: resource manager holding category counters and list head
local_names.v7: local 256-byte buffer for the already-deleted message
local_names.v4: node state word selector for category counter selection

operations.description: ReferenceCountedResourceRelease(a2) decrements the node reference count; the removal path is only entered when it returns 0
Continue only when the release returned 0 and a2[34] is also 0; otherwise return the release result unchanged
If the node state word a2[39] equals -1, StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v7, aAlreadyDeleted) formats the already-deleted diagnostic message into the local buffer

Select and decrement the category counter from bits 0x20 and 0x100 of a2[39]: both set decrements this[7] (+0x1C), only bit 0x20 decrements this[8] (+0x20), only bit 0x100 decrements this[5] (+0x14), neither decrements this[6] (+0x18)
Splice the node out of the doubly linked list: if a2[47] is non-zero write a2[48] to *(a2[47]+192); if a2[48] is non-zero write a2[47] to *(a2[48]+188)
If this[9] equals the removed node, the list head this+0x24 is advanced to a2[48] (the next neighbor)
ArrayCleanupWithDualFree(a2) frees the node's internal array allocations
EmptyStub_7470(a2) runs the stub cleanup callback for the node
Decrement the total resource count: this[4] (+0x10) = this[4] - 1
Return 0 (the successful-release result); invoked by sub_54AC70, QueueResourceCleanup and sub_5574B0

unresolved: Meaning of the state bits 0x20/0x100 and the values at a2[34], a2[47], a2[48] (node internals) are not determinable from this packet
The offsets 192 and 188 in the neighbor pointers are node-internal links without further packet evidence
